reviews.title: Just a straight up lie
reviews.text: If you found this app on Google trying to figure out how to connect a tv to WiFi without the remote, this app does not work. It will come up on a Google search as “Connect TV remote without WiFi” but it has to be on the same WiFi as the TV to work. Just like all of the other apps. It just makes you get a subscription before it tells you that. False advertising. Please don’t give these people your money

reviews.title: Need Remote to Allow Access, Costs Money
reviews.text: My two major issues with this app is 1) it cost $10 PER WEEK to use. That in my opinion seems very excessive for just using my phone as a remote to my tv. 2) at least for my Samsung TV, to use this app as a remote it requires using your current Samsung remote to allow access. If I knew where my TV Remote was at the moment, I would not have needed to download this app...
